basis: The Region R pie chart (chart_1) shows two labeled slices: the light-gray slice is printed 58% and the red slice is printed 42%. The legend binds the light-gray swatch to Public Transit and the red swatch to Car, so Public Transit's share is 58% and Car's share is 42%. The routing criterion is the majority-share transport mode; a majority share is >50%, and 58% > 50% (whereas 42% < 50%). Therefore Public Transit is the majority-share mode and maps to the matching follow-up option.
option_label: Route Public Transit to majority-preference policy follow-up
